受到极大影响。

我们已举行会议讨论应对此事的措施，并决议在必要时给予工人支持。兹请求各公共团体提出建议，以期解决争端，维护社区和平与秩序。

致“怠工”罢工工人的慰问信。

你们与上海电力公司管理层的争执已持续约20天。由于管理层采取顽固态度，争端尚未解决。然而，你们维持了电流供应，这表明你们考虑到了公众利益。我们对你们的行动深感满意。除请求上海第一、第二特别区市民联合会讨论解决争端的措施外，我们还请求工部局华董继续致力于调解。希望你们继续维持对公众的电力供应。

宁波同乡会致工部局函。

上海电力公司顽固拒绝考虑既有利于公司又有利于劳工的建议。公司的这种行为激怒了工人，影响了所有用户的便利，并构成了对社区和平与秩序的漠视。若发生任何不幸事件，责任应由公司承担。

兹请求贵局邀请董事会秘书琼斯先生（Mr. Jones），与袁履登先生、黄绍莱先生、奚新洛先生以及当地党部和其他政治机关的代表合作进行调解。双方

pages.en:
- 29 -

management and the labourers should be instructed to make
concessions so that the dispute might be amicably settled.

LETTER FROM THE CHEKIANG FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

According to a report from our members in the
International Settlement, the "go-slow" strike in the
Shanghai Power Company was caused by the action of the
Company in disregarding the conditions of employment of
workers and the failure of negotiations with the management.
Fortunately, the distribution workers are still observing
the order of the Union to maintain the distribution of
electricity in order not to affect the peace and order in
the community.

The dispute in the Shanghai Power Company has
become serious and it is inevitable that a critical situation
will ensue and our members will suffer heavy losses.

We hereby request you to instruct both the management
and the workers to open negotiations, and to bring about an
early settlement. Any party which adopts an obstinate
attitude cannot evade responsibility for the forthcoming losses.

LETTER FROM THE ZANGCHOW FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

Of late, newspapers report that the "go-slow"
strike in the Shanghai Power Company arose through the
frequent dismissal of workers by the management. Owing to
the firm attitude adopted by the management, the labour si-
tuation has reached serious dimensions. The question of the
entire safety of the community is at stake, and should
any untoward incidents occur, the citizens would be indirectly
affected.

The Council should pay attention to the matter,
otherwise the Council cannot evade responsibility for any
pages.zh:
- 29 -

管理层和劳工均应被指示作出妥协，以便友好地解决争端。

浙江同乡会致工部局函。

据我在国际租界内的会员报告，上海电力公司的“怠工”罢工是由于公司无视工人的雇佣条件以及与管理层谈判失败所致。幸而，配电工人仍遵守工会命令，维持电力分配，以免影响社区的和平与秩序。

上海电力公司的争端已变得严重，随之出现危急局面不可避免，我们的会员将遭受重大损失。

兹请求贵局指示管理层和工人开启谈判，促成早日解决。任何一方若采取顽固态度，均无法逃避对即将到来的损失所负的责任。

常州同乡会致工部局函。

近日报纸报道，上海电力公司的“怠工”罢工是由于管理层频繁解雇工人所致。由于管理层采取强硬态度，劳资局势已达到严重程度。整个社区的安全问题岌岌可危，若发生任何不幸事件，市民将间接受到影响。

董事会应关注此事，否则，尽管责任应由上海电力公司承担，但董事会仍无法逃避对可能发生的任何

pages.en:
- 30 -

trouble which may arise although the blame should be borne
by the Shanghai Power Company.

We hereby request you to order the Company to
effect an early settlement of the dispute.

LETTER FROM THE KIANGSU FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

Most of our members are subscribers of the Shanghai
Power Company. The present "go-slow" strike arose through
the bad treatment of workers by the Company, and to date,
the dispute which could have been easily settled, has been
spreading day by day as a result of the obstinate attitude
on the part of the Company.

In consideration of the rights of the subscribers,
the workers are still maintaining the distribution of
electricity.

The situation has been growing steadily worse
owing to the insincerity of the Company, and in the event of
the management failing to see reason in the near future,
the hands would be compelled to abandon the maintenance of
electricity distribution. Consequently, untoward incidents
might occur, thereby causing our members to sustain business
and other kinds of losses for which the Company should be
held to blame.

The Council, being a supervisory organ, is requested
to place restrictions on the unreasonable delay in a settlement
by the Company so that our members may not be affected.

SUPPORT OF VARIOUS LABOUR UNIONS.

About 100 labour unions, including the Shanghai
Postal Workers Union, the Postal Staff Members Union, the 4th
District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union, the Dried Goods
Trade Workers Union, the 1st District Ordure Coolies Union,
the 10th District Cotton Weaving Trade Workers Union, the
pages.zh:
- 30 -

骚乱所负的责任。

兹请求贵局命令公司早日解决争端。

江苏同乡会致工部局函。

我处大多数会员均为上海电力公司的用户。目前的“怠工”罢工是由于公司虐待工人所致，迄今为止，本可轻易解决的争端因公司采取顽固态度而日益蔓延。

考虑到用户的权利，工人们仍在维持电力分配。

由于公司缺乏诚意，局势 steadily 恶化，如果管理层在近期仍不明智行事，工人们将被迫放弃维持电力分配。因此，可能会发生不幸事件，导致我处会员遭受商业及其他方面的损失，对此公司应承担责任。

董事会作为监督机构，兹请求对公司不合理地拖延解决争端加以限制，以免我处会员受到影响。

各工会的支持。

包括上海邮政工人工会、邮政职员公会、第四区卷烟业工人工会、百货业工人工会、第一区粪夫工会、第十区棉织业工人工会、

pages.en:
-, 31 -

4th District Silk Spinning Trade Workers Union, etc.
on November 13 issued a joint manifesto emphasizing their
support to the strikers.

In a letter dated September 29 to the 8th
District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union,
the Postal Workers Union states that the postal workers
will support the strikers.

At 2 p.m. October 25, the Shanghai General
Labour Union held a meeting at which about 100 persons
representing some 70 labour unions were present.

The following resolutions were passed:-

1. That the various labour unions do their utmost
to contribute funds to the "go-slow" strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company and that a petition be submitted
to the General Labour Union to draw up detailed measures
governing the collection of the contributions.

2. That the various labour unions issue manifestos
concerning the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company.

DIARY ON IMPORTANT AFFAIRS.

September 29. The 2,000 workers of the new plant became
angry when the negotiations opened yesterday by six
foremen with Mr. Elmer, of the plant were rejected.
The workers then voluntarily commenced a "go-slow"
strike from this morning.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union immediately submitted a report to
the local Tangpu and other political organs, and issued
a letter addressed to the workers.

The management issued a circular instructing
the strikers to resume work before 2 o'clock in the
afternoon, but up to the evening, none of the strikers
returned to duty.
pages.zh:
-, 31 -

第四区缫丝业工人工会等在内的约100个工会，于11月13日发表联合宣言，强调支持罢工者。

邮政工人工会在9月29日致第八区水电业工人工会的信中表示，邮政工人将支持罢工者。

10月25日下午2时，上海总工会举行会议，约有代表70个工会的100人出席。

通过以下决议：-

1. 各工会尽力为上海电力公司“怠工”罢工者捐款，并向总工会提交请愿书，制定详细的捐款征集措施。

2. 各工会就上海电力公司的劳资纠纷发表宣言。

重要事项日记。

9月29日。新厂2000名工人因昨日由六名领班与新厂埃尔默先生（Mr. Elmer）进行的谈判被拒而感到愤怒。工人们遂于今晨自愿开始“怠工”罢工。

第四区水电业工人工会立即向当地党部和其他政治机关提交报告，并向工人发出一封信。

管理层发布通告，指示罢工者在下午2点前复工，但直至晚上，无一名罢工者返回岗位。

pages.en:
- 32 -

September 30. The gate of the new plant was closed by the management. The workers were refused entry to the premises but informed that they had been discharged.

Next morning, the entire body of hands called at the General Office on Kiangsi Road and asked for the payment of pensions, but without result. At noon, representatives were detailed to submit an appeal to the S.M.C. asking for assistance and were received by Mr. Jones, Secretary, and Mr. Ho Tuh-kwei, Associate Secretary of the Council, who informed them that a reply would be given after they had discussed the matter with the Company.

In the afternoon, the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union called a meeting of chiefs of various departments of both the new and the old plants, at which it was resolved to form a "Go-slow" Strike Committee.

October 1. About 800 workers of the old plant on Fearon Road joined the "go-slow" strike this morning, but the distribution workers of the new plant still remained to maintain the distribution of electricity.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union entertained local newspapermen and made a report on the circumstances attending the strike.

Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. gave a reply to workers to the effect that negotiations had been opened with the Shanghai Power Company, but owing to the latter's firm attitude, no result had been arrived at.

October 2. The Company engaged a large number of white Russians commencing operations from to-day.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union despatched a letter to the S.M.C. requesting it to uphold justice.
pages.zh:
- 32 -

9月30日。新厂大门被管理层关闭。工人被拒绝进入厂区，但被告知已被解雇。

次日早晨，全体工人前往江西路总办事处要求支付养老金，但未果。中午，派出代表向工部局提交求助申请，由董事会秘书琼斯先生和董事会副秘书何德奎先生（Ho Tuh-kwei）接见，他们告知代表，在与公司讨论此事后将给予答复。

下午，第四区水电业工人工会召集新旧两厂各部门主管开会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。

10月1日。今晨，斐伦路（Fearon Road）老厂约800名工人加入“怠工”罢工，但新厂的配电工人仍留守以维持电力分配。

第四区水电业工人工会招待当地记者，并报告了罢工的相关情况。

工部局琼斯先生回复工人称，已与上海电力公司开启谈判，但由于后者态度强硬，未达成任何结果。

10月2日。公司雇佣了大量白俄人员，并于今日开始运作。

第四区水电业工人工会致函工部局，请求其主持公道。

pages.en:
- 33 -

About 100 local labour unions issued a
manifesto emphasizing their support of the strikers.
October 3. The strikers detailed Kyi Wen-fu, Chu Hou-
sun and 4 others to submit an appeal to the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai requesting assistance.
The Company notified the strikers to receive
their pay at the Badge Room in Yangtsepoo. Up to
5.30 p.m. none of the strikers' called for the wages.
The local Tangpu and the Social Bureau
detailed officials Tai Yu-hang and Chu King-tao to call
at the General Office to interview Mr. Heald, Assistant
General Manager, and to proceed with mediations, but
without result.
The Company despatched officials to request
the wire-cutting workers to resume work, which proposal
was accepted by the Union in consideration of the
public welfare.
October 4. In view of the serious situation, we held
an emergency meeting and despatched a telegram to the
People's Movement Committee of the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters requesting it to detail officials to Shanghai
to control the situation.
The entire body of foremen of the two plants
resolved to join the "go-slow" strike and the staff
members were also reported to have the intention of
joining the movement.
October 5. We instructed the 4th District Waterworks &
Electricity Trade Workers Union to order the distribution
workers to maintain supply and not to participate in
the movement unless they were compelled to do so.
The Company adopted an obstinate attitude
and emphasized their intention to reject all proposals.
October 6. On the morning, Chu Hsueh-van, Chow Hsueh-
hsiang and Shao Hsu-bah, committee members of our
pages.zh:
- 33 -

约100个当地工会发表宣言，强调支持罢工者。
10月3日。罢工者派遣纪文甫（Kyi Wen-fu）、朱厚孙（Chu Hou-sun）等四人向大上海市政府提交请愿书，请求援助。
公司通知罢工者前往杨树浦 Badge Room（原文不清，或指徽章室/登记室）领取薪水。截至下午5时30分，无罢工者前来领取工资。
当地党部和社会局派遣戴玉航（Tai Yu-hang）和朱锦涛（Chu King-tao）两位官员前往总办事处会见助理总经理希尔德先生（Mr. Heald），并进行调解，但未果。
公司派遣官员请求剪线工人复工，工会出于公共利益考虑接受了该提议。
10月4日。鉴于局势严重，我们举行紧急会议，并向国民党中央总部民众运动委员会发电报，请求其派遣官员来沪控制局势。
两厂全体领班决议加入“怠工”罢工，据报道职员也有意加入该运动。
10月5日。我们指示第四区水电业工人工会命令配电工人维持供应，除非被迫，否则不参与该运动。
公司采取顽固态度，并强调其拒绝所有提议的意图。
10月6日。上午，我会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van）、周学湘（Chow Hsueh-hsiang）和邵徐八（Shao Hsu-bah）拜访大上海市政府秘书长余井塘先生（O.K. Yue），与其讨论应对局势的措施。
公司试图雇佣安得森·梅耶公司（Anderson Meyer Company）的工人替代罢工者。该尝试未果。
10月7日。除向当地党部和其他政治机关提交请愿书以立即促成争端早日解决外，我们通知所有工会尽力提供财政援助。
10月8日。今晨，全体华籍职员加入罢工，职员互助会和第四区水电业工人工会发表了联合宣言。
晚间，我们在大西阳餐厅（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）宴请各公共团体领导人，并在席间报告了■围绕罢工的■情况。
10月9日。由于管理层拒绝调解提议，各地方团体感到愤慨■。国际租界华人纳税会和第17分区市民联合会致函工部局，请求其立即 devising 办法促成争端解决。
10月11日。全体华籍职员在南市小西门青年宣传团社址举行大会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。
英文声明由

pages.en:
- 34 -
Union, called on Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, and discussed with
him measures to cope with the situation.
The Company attempted to engage the workers
of the Anderson Meyer Company to replace the strikers.
The attempt was futile.
October 7. Apart from submitting a petition to the local
Tangpu and other political organs to immediately bring
about an early settlement of the dispute, we notified
all labour unions to do their utmost to give financial
assistance.
October 8. The entire body of Chinese staff members
joined the strike this morning and a joint manifesto
was issued by the Staff Members Mutual Benefit Society
and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union.
We gave an entertainment in the evening ■
to various leaders of public bodies at the Dah Si Yang
Restaurant at which a report on the ■ circumstances
surrounding the strike was made.
October 9. The various local bodies became indignant
■ because the management rejected the offers of
mediation. Letters from the Chinese Ratepayers·
Association in the International Settlement and the
17th Branch District Citizens Federation were sent to
the S.M.C. requesting it to immediately devise ways
and means to bring about a settlement of the dispute.
October 11. The entire body of Chinese staff members
held a general meeting in the premises of the Youths
Propaganda Group Society at Small West Gate, Nantao,
at which it was resolved to form a "Go-slow" Strike
Committee.
An English statement was published by the
pages.zh:
- 34 -
联合会代表拜访了大上海市政府秘书长岳开先（O.K. Yue）先生，并与他讨论了应对局势的措施。
公司试图雇用安德森·迈耶公司（Anderson Meyer Company）的工人来替代罢工者。
该尝试未获成功。
10月7日。除了向当地塘浦及其他政治机构提交请愿书，要求立即促成纠纷早日解决外，我们还通知所有工会尽力提供财政援助。
10月8日。全体华籍职员于今晨加入罢工，职员互益会与第四区水电业工会联合发表了宣言。
晚间，我们在大西洋菜馆（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）为各公共团体的领导人举行了招待会，会上就罢工的■相关情况作了报告。
10月9日。由于资方拒绝调解提议，各地方团体感到愤慨。■国际租界华人纳税会及第十七支区市民联合会致函工部局，要求其立即制定办法，以促成纠纷的解决。
10月11日。全体华籍职员在南市小西门青年宣传团社址举行大会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。
一份英文声明由

pages.en:
- 35 -

Company, in which cunning refutations regarding the
cause of and the responsibility for the present
trouble were made.

The Zangchow Fellow Provincials Association,
the Kiangsu Fellow Provincials Association, etc.
despatched letters to the S.M.C. and the Shanghai Power
Company urging them to immediately settle the dispute,
otherwise the Company would be to blame for any incidents.

October 12. The People's Movement Committee of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters despatched a telegram
to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the local
Tangpu instructing them to immediately offer proposals.

More Chinese staff members were reported to
have joined the strike.

The Chekiang Fellow Provincials Association
and various local shop-owners associations sent letters
to the S.M.C. stressing their opinions re the present
trouble.

October 13. The various local fellow provincials
associations yesterday evening held a joint meeting at
which measures to support the strikers of the Shanghai
Power Company were discussed. The Ningpo Fellow
Provincials Association sent a letter to the members of
the S.M.C. expressing anger over the disregard of the
rights of the public, and urging them to immediately
draw up measures to control the trouble.

October 14. In refuting the open letters published in the
advertisement columns of various local newspapers by
the Shanghai Power Company to mislead the public, a
letter addressed to the public bodies was jointly signed
and issued by the entire body of workers, numbering
about 2,000.
pages.zh:
- 35 -

公司，其中就当前纠纷的起因及责任问题提出了狡辩。

常州同乡会、江苏同乡会等致函工部局（S.M.C.）及上海电力公司，敦促其立即解决争端，否则公司将对该引发的任何事件承担责任。

10月12日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会致电大上海市政府及当地党部，指示其立即提出方案。

据报道，又有更多华籍职员加入罢工行列。

浙江同乡会及各本地商号公会致函工部局，强调其对当前纠纷的意见。

10月13日。各本地同乡会于昨晚举行联席会议，讨论支持上海电力公司罢工工人的措施。宁波同乡会致函工部局董事，对漠视公众权利表示愤慨，并敦促其立即制定控制局势的措施。

10月14日。为驳斥上海电力公司在各本地报纸广告栏刊登的旨在误导公众的公开信，全体约2000名工人联合签署并向各公共团体发出了一封信函。

pages.en:
- 36 -

October 15. The "go-slow" strike continued and the
labour situation still remained serious.

October 16. The Chinese staff members who had joined
the strike resumed work due to threats and inducements
by the Company, but none of the workers on strike
called at the plant to resume.

October 17. Messrs. Yu Yah-ching and Yuan Lee-tung,
Chinese members of the S.M.C., were requested by
this Union to mediate.

October 18. This Union despatched a letter to the S.M.C.
urging it to settle the labour trouble in the Shanghai
Power Company. Local newspapermen were entertained,
a report on the strike made and a manifesto issued.
The strikers detailed representatives to make appeals
to parties concerned.

October 19. The Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce
sent a letter to the S.M.C. requesting it to warn and
correct the policy adopted by tl Shanghai Power Company.
The various fellow provincials & sociations also wrote
to the S.M.C. asking for an early settlement of the
trouble.

October 20. The Ministry of Industry detailed Mr. Pao
Kuo-hwa, Chief of the 4th Section of the Labour
Department, to Shanghai to make an investigation into
the S.P.C. dispute.
Mr. Bell, Chairman of the S.M.C., offered
proposals.

October 22. The various local fellow provincials
associations issued a manifesto supporting the S.P.C.
strikers. Letters to console the strikers and to the
Chinese members of the Council to offer proposals were
despatched.
pages.zh:
- 36 -

10月15日。“怠工”罢工持续，劳工局势依然严峻。

10月16日。加入罢工的华籍职员因受到公司的威胁和利诱而复工，但罢工工人中无人到厂复工。

10月17日。本工会请求工部局华董余雅景（Yu Yah-ching，音译）和袁立东（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）先生进行调解。

10月18日。本工会致函工部局，敦促其解决上海电力公司的劳资纠纷。招待了本地新闻记者，发布了罢工报告并发表宣言。罢工者派出代表向有关各方呼吁。

10月19日。上海总商会致函工部局，要求其警告并纠正上海电力公司采取的政策。各同乡会亦致函工部局，要求早日解决纠纷。

10月20日。实业部派遣劳工司第四科科长包国华（Pao Kuo-hwa，音译）先生来沪调查上海电力公司（S.P.C.）纠纷。
工部局主席贝尔（Bell）先生提出了建议。

10月22日。各本地同乡会发表宣言支持上海电力公司罢工工人。发出了慰问罢工工人及要求参事会华董提出方案的信函。

pages.en:
- 37 -

October 23. At 2 p.m. the Social Bureau held a meeting
at which Yih Ziang-kao and Shao Hsu-bah of this
Union were present to interview Mr. Pao Kuo-hwa,
special delegate of the Ministry of Industry, and
to inform him of the true facts of the strike.
Measures to deal with the trouble were discussed.

October 24. At 3 p.m. Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General
of the S.M.C., invited Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, member of
the Council of the Chinese Municipality, to arrange
measures to cope with the dispute.

October 25. At 2 p.m. we called a meeting of various
labour unions to discuss measures to support the
strikers. A statement requesting the public support
of the S.P.C. strikers was issued.

October 26. The People's Movement Committee of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters detailed an official
Lee Jen-tso to Shanghai to make an investigation.
He made a detailed inquiry at the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and the local Tangpu. The circumstances
surrounding the labour trouble were closely investigated
in an interview with Chu Hsueh-van and Shao Hsu-bah,
Committee members of this Union.

October 27. The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union submitted five demands in addition
with reasons to Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of
the S.M.C., through Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, thus facilitating
his intervention.

October 28. Mr. Lee Jen-tso of the People's Movement
Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
called on Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai. Measures to control
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company were
devised.
pages.zh:
- 37 -

10月23日。下午2时，社会局举行会议，本工会的易相高（Yih Ziang-kao，音译）和邵许波（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）出席，会见实业部特派员包国华先生，向其通报罢工的真实情况。讨论了处理该纠纷的措施。

10月24日。下午3时，工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生邀请上海市参事会成员杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun，音译）先生，商议应对纠纷的措施。

10月25日。下午2时，我们召集各工会开会，讨论支持罢工者的措施。发表了请求公众支持上海电力公司罢工工人的声明。

10月26日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会派遣官员李仁佐（Lee Jen-tso，音译）来沪调查。他在大上海市政府及当地党部进行了详细查询。通过与本工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van，音译）和邵许波（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）的面谈，对劳资纠纷的相关情况进行了严密调查。

10月27日。第四区水电业工会通过杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun，音译）先生，向工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生提交了五项要求及理由，以便其介入调解。

10月28日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会的李仁佐（Lee Jen-tso，音译）先生拜访了大上海市政府秘书长岳开先（O.K. Yue，音译）先生。制定了控制上海电力公司劳资纠纷的措施。

pages.en:
- 1 -

CIRCUMSTANCES LEADING TO THE STRIKE.

After taking over the Electricity Department of the
Shanghai Municipal Council, the Shanghai Power Company
immediately devised measures to increase the electricity charges
and to dismiss long-service and meritorious workers with a
view to detaining the pensions which had been provided by the
M.C. It is estimated that about 400 workers have been
dismissed.

The entire body of hands became panic-stricken and
commenced the organisation of a labour union which was formally
inaugurated on July 25 last year. Reasonable demands that no
dismissal of workers be made without cause and that the pensions
be not detained were submitted to the management and rejected
by it. In the meantime, the dismissal of hands continued.
Van Lih-zung, a member of the Standing Committee of the Union,
was discharged.

When the demands made by representatives of the
workers were rejected and the discussions between the foremen
of the new and the old plants and Mr. Heald, Secretary-General
of the Company, ended in failure, the hands became angry and
suggested that a strike to cope with the situation be called.

In view of the fact that the electricity supply is
a public utility and that the suspension of the service for
even one day would greatly affect the community, we did our
utmost to avert a strike. Later, the Union submitted a petition
to the local Tangpu and other political organs requesting them
to detail officials to mediate. The workers of various
departments then made a written request to the Company to
accept the offer of mediation, but the request was rejected.

In July this year, a "go-slow" strike broke out
when the Company refused to pay the pension of a foreman
named Yang Ah-chop of the new plant, but work was eventually
resumed on the advice of the General Labour Union. On July 3
pages.zh:
- 1 -

导致罢工的经过。

上海电力公司在接管工部局电气处后，立即 devised 措施提高电费，并解雇长期服务且有功劳的工人，意图扣留由工部局提供的养老金。据估计，约有400名工人被解雇。

全体工人陷入恐慌，开始组织工会，该工会于去年7月25日正式成立。向管理层提交了不得无故解雇工人及不得扣留养老金的合理要求，但被管理层拒绝。与此同时，解雇工人的行为仍在继续。工会常务委员万立宗（Van Lih-zung，音译）被解职。

当工人代表提出的要求被拒绝，且新旧厂房的领班与公司总办希尔德（Heald）先生的谈判以失败告终时，工人们感到愤怒，建议举行罢工以应对局势。

鉴于电力供应属于公用事业，即使停止服务一天也会对社会造成巨大影响，我们竭尽全力避免罢工。随后，工会向当地党部及其他政治机关递交请愿书，请求其派员调解。各部门工人随后书面请求公司接受调解提议，但该请求被拒绝。

今年7月，当公司拒绝支付新厂房一名名为杨阿卓（Yang Ah-chop，音译）的领班的养老金时，爆发了“怠工”罢工，但在总工会的建议下最终复工。7月3日

pages.en:
- 2 -

the workers despatched 4 representatives named Nyi Wen-fu,
Pen Yun-ling, Chen Pao-kan and Chang Zai-am to submit once
more the lawful demands to the Company but instead of accepting
them, the Company dismissed four men on the 5th. This action
increased the anger of the entire body of workers and was
the cause of the strike.

Chu Hsueh-yun and Jiao Hsu-boh, two committee members,
then requested Messrs. Yuen Lee-tung, Zoe Hsin-loh and Dr. Wong
Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce,
to make suggestions.

In September the Company dismissed three more workers
named Shih Ah-pao, Tai Jung-han and Ying Ping-kun of the new
plant. Negotiations over these dismissals were opened by the
foremen of the plant with Mr. Elmer, the Managing-Director,
but without result.

The entire body of workers could not tolerate this
any longer and went on a "go-slow" strike from September 29.
Thus, the labour trouble which had been brewing for more than
one year finally broke owing to incessant acts of oppressions
of workers on the part of the Company.

A TELEGRAM TO THE CENTRAL AUTHORITIES TO DETAIL
CIRCUMSTANCES TO SHANGHAI TO CONTROL THE SITUATION.

The General Labour Union on October 4 sent the following
telegram to the People's Movement Direction Committee
of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters at Nanking:-

"About several hundred Chinese workers of the Shanghai
Power Company have been dismissed by the management on divers
dates and pensions of workers provided by the S.M.C. have been
detained. The workers have requested the Chinese members of
the S.M.C., the local Tangpu and other political organs to offer
suggestions, but owing to the obstinate attitude of the
management, the disputes existing between the employers and
the workers have remained unsettled.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

工人派遣倪文福（Nyi Wen-fu，音译）、彭云岭（Pen Yun-ling，音译）、陈宝堪（Chen Pao-kan，音译）和张在安（Chang Zai-am，音译）四名代表再次向公司提交合法要求，但公司非但未予接受，反而于5日解雇了这四名工人。这一举动加剧了全体工人的愤怒，并成为罢工的起因。

随后，两名委员朱学云（Chu Hsueh-yun，音译）和焦许波（Jiao Hsu-boh，音译）请求袁立东（Yuen Lee-tung，音译）、左辛洛（Zoe Hsin-loh，音译）先生及上海总商会会长王晓籁（Wong Shao-lai，音译）博士提出建议。

9月，公司又解雇了新厂房的三名工人，分别为施阿宝（Shih Ah-pao，音译）、戴荣汉（Tai Jung-han，音译）和应平坤（Ying Ping-kun，音译）。厂房领班与总经理埃尔默（Elmer）先生就这些解雇事宜展开谈判，但无果而终。

全体工人再也无法容忍，自9月29日起实行“怠工”罢工。因此，酝酿了一年多的劳资纠纷，终于因公司不断压迫工人而爆发。

致电中央当局派员来沪控制局势的电文。

总工会于10月4日向南京国民党中央党部民众运动指导委员会发送了以下电报：

“上海电力公司数百名华籍工人被管理层在不同日期解雇，且由工部局提供的工人养老金被扣留。工人已请求工部局华董、当地党部及其他政治机关提出建议，但由于管理层态度顽固，雇主与工人之间存在的纠纷仍未解决。

"The management recently dismissed 3 workers on
false accusations, and the workers of the new plant, being
out of patience, went on a "go-slow" strike from September 29.
The stubborn attitude of the management caused the hands
of the old plant to join the movement from October 2.

"In view of the fact that the electricity supply
has an important connection with the community, we instructed
the workers to maintain the distribution of electricity with
a view to preventing untoward incidents.

"We hereby request you to detail officials to
Shanghai immediately to devise measures to put an end to the
dispute with the co-operation of the local Tangpu and other
political organs."

GENERAL LABOUR UNION'S INSTRUCTIONS TO WORKERS.

"Unable to bear the intolerable oppression of
workers by the Shanghai Power Company, the entire body of
workers went on a "go-slow" strike. The strikers who have
due consideration for the peace and order in the community
are maintaining the distribution of electricity.

"According to a report from the workers Union, the
3 shifts of workers operating the distribution of electricity
have repeatedly requested permission to join the movement.

"It is true that the distribution workers are
willing to act in concert because their hardships have become
greater day by day. Should the distribution of electricity
be stopped for one day, terror would reign in the community
and it is probable that other incidents might arise.

"Apart from requesting the Central authorities,
the local Tangpu and other political organs to devise ways
and means immediately to cope with the dispute with a view
to bringing about an early settlement, we hereby instruct
the workers Union to notify the distribution workers not to

“管理层最近以虚假指控解雇了3名工人，新厂房的工人因失去耐心，自9月29日起实行‘怠工’罢工。管理层的顽固态度导致旧厂房的工人自10月2日起加入该运动。

“鉴于电力供应与社会有着重要关联，我们指示工人维持电力分配，以防止意外事件发生。

“特此请求贵会立即派员来沪，与当地党部及其他政治机关合作，制定措施以结束纠纷。”

总工会给工人的指示。

“因无法忍受上海电力公司对工人的难以容忍的压迫，全体工人实行‘怠工’罢工。顾及社区和平秩序的罢工者正在维持电力分配。

“据工人工会报告，负责电力分配的三班工人多次请求允许加入该运动。

“确实，由于生活日益艰难，配电工人愿意协同行动。如果电力分配停止一天，社会将陷入恐慌，并可能引发其他事件。

“除了请求中央当局、当地党部及其他政治机关立即制定应对纠纷的办法以期早日解决外，我们特此指示工人工会通知配电工人不要

stop the distribution of electricity unless they were
compelled to do so."

LOCAL PUBLIC BODIES INTERESTED.

The General Labour Union gave an entertainment on
the evening of October 8 to about 60 leaders of various public
bodies, including Wong Shao-lai of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber
of Commerce, Ling Kong-han of the Bankers Association, Luo
Ji-qing of the Chinese Ratepayers Association, Chang Ts-lie of
the Nanking Road Street Union, Loh Fah-hoong of the Nantao
Tramway Company, Liu Hoong-sung, an industrial magnate, Wong
Tien-peng and Ju Han-ts of the newspaper circles, etc.

Chu Hsueh-van, who presided, reported that at the
beginning of the trouble, local Tangpu and other political
organs and Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C., had attempted
to mediate, but without result, owing to the firm attitude
adopted by the Company. Since the taking over of the premises
by the Shanghai Power Company, about 400 hands have been
dismissed. It is recalled that the Power Company when controlled
by the S.M.C. seldom dismissed its employees, but general
dismissals for trivial offences are now the order of the day.
Recently, the dismissal of three hands without sufficient
cause, incited the other employees to strike. Owing to the
obstinate attitude of the management, the strike has reached
its present magnitude. The workers are willing to make
concessions in order to prevent the trouble from increasing,
and causing serious inconvenience to the public. The leaders
are expected to submit proposals which will be accepted by
the General Labour Union and will be the means of ending the
dispute at an early date.

Ling Kong-han of the Bankers Association in submitting
his views about the present labour dispute stated that the
public must first ascertain the "sincerity" of the management
in conducting negotiations. If the management is at fault,
pages.zh:
